answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x with onset ~30 minutes after a deploy, concurrent with peak settlement writes. Circuit breaking would shed customer writes and violates the objective; read-replica routing historically offloaded report/read traffic, not settlement writes; no regional fault is indicated. Pre-provisioned headroom has absorbed planned surges, but a 5x regression this tightly timed to a release is more consistent with a bad build than with a familiar daily peak. Prefer a small guarded rollback toward the last stable write path (staged/canary gating previously caught bad builds quickly) while verifying rollback safety (b1) and whether capacity only works if added before the surge (b3). Settlement is in-flight, so any change can put downstream money movement at risk; peak load remains a plausible alternate cause.
